description: S4 iac-env findings: one fingerprint per credential

wire.title: Infra health: 2 critical finding(s)
wire.body:
**Infra health check — CRITICAL**

- frigg/iac-env `cloudflare_api_token` is OUT OF SYNC with `secret/ansible/cloudflare/api-token` — Frigg is authenticating with a stale/different token. Re-sync per the Cloudflare section of docs/procedures/credential-rotation.md.
- frigg/iac-env `netbox_api_token` does NOT authenticate against NetBox (HTTP 403) — Frigg TF applies against terraform/netbox will fail. Rotate/re-sync per the NetBox section of docs/procedures/credential-rotation.md.
